US House Republicans Block Impeachment Effort Against Defense Secretary Hegseth

Efforts in the U.S. House of Representatives to impeach Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth were blocked by House Republicans. A motion to impeach Hegseth failed to advance. Eleven Democrats and seven Republicans did not vote on the motion.
